scope: Engineering defaults for isolated synthetic realms; applicability review and live evidence are required for production.

institutions.population: Separate synthetic institutional human population; no machine or institutional authority is inferred.

administrators.population: Separate master administrative plane; temporary bootstrap access is not permanent-administrator qualification.
